To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the arc energy increases with the contact coating and the opening speed.
the arc damage is proportional to the arc energy.
the arc energy and the current level are the two parameters which are responsible for the damage of the connector during live disconnection.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of arcing damage to connectors in 42 V automotive systems.
the development of a new generation of connectors able to withstand the arcing energy generated during the unplugging of the 42 V automotive connectors.
the development of a methodology to quantify the level of arcing damage of a connector and to correlate the results with the basic insertion criteria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the arc resistance of an interconnection solution depends not only on the arc energy, but also on the current level, and the arc resistance increases with increasing arc energy and current level.
the arc energy is the most important parameter for the evaluation of the connector arcing damage.
the arcing damage is not only related to the arcing energy, as previously thought, but that it is more related to the overheating due to heat conduction by the arc.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the arc energy is a relevant parameter for the evaluation of the arc resistance capability of connectors.
the arcing damage is a function of the contact resistance, which is a function of current and contact geometry.
the arc resistance is mainly related to the material and the geometry of the contact and to the contact coating.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the arcing damage is mainly due to the arc energy and the current level and the insertion effort is not a good criterion for the evaluation of the damage.
the arc energy is not the unique criterion to evaluate the damage of a connector.
the insertion force can be used to estimate the level of arcing damage and to predict the life of the connector.
